The algorithms were translated and adapted to Rust, with project-owned FFI and tests.
Upstream source fingerprints are recorded in PROVENANCE.json.

The spherical t-design data retains its original bytes and source attribution in
assets/README.md (M. Graf and D. Potts, 2011; University of Vienna point sets).
